description.narrative: The proposed project is based on the construction of a "Political Innovation Lab" (“PIL”) that we will carry out within the framework of JS’ Young Leaders' Political Training School, a space created by and for young people. The PIL is a new initiative from JS that has only been held once before, in 2022. We will hold two national meetings where DSU will attend the first of these on November 11th and 12th, 2023. Young people aged 18 to 30 from all provinces of Argentina will participate. General Objectives: 1- To be a place for political reflection and training for all the activists of the Socialist Youth of Argentina scattered throughout the country. 2- To create the PIL as a space where participants can learn new methods and tools to create high-impact projects based on the promotion of rights, both for young people and Argentineans in general, and sustainable development goals across the whole country. Specific Objectives: 1- To share tools and methods to strengthen voluntary work and activism. 2- To provide theoretical and practical training tools for members of The Socialist Youth of Argentina to help us understand the context in which we live, and how to lead organisations capable of engaging, mobilising, and reaching out to other young people. These may be both within the structure of the Partido Socialista de Argentina and in other organisations. 3- Strengthen bonds among colleagues who have taken on or wish to assume leadership and management roles within the student federations, university groups or labour movements. 4- Foster new international connections that promote the exchange of democratic values. Our plan is to use this first version of the PIL to kickstart long term projects around Argentina, and to then use later versions of the PIL to share experiences across the different projects, find new members for each project group, and set the overall project strategy for the JS.
